(the "Company", "Conagra Brands", "we", "us", or "our"), headquartered in Chicago, is one of North America’s leading branded food companies. We combine a 100-year history of making quality food with agility and a relentless focus on collaboration and innovation. The Company’s portfolio is continuously evolving to satisfy consumers’ ever-changing food preferences. Conagra’s brands include Birds Eye ® , Duncan Hines ® , Healthy Choice ® , Marie Callender’s ® , Reddi-wip ® , Slim Jim ® , Angie’s ® BOOMCHICKAPOP ® , and many more. We began as a Midwestern flour-milling company and entered other commodity-based businesses throughout our history.
